page.layout: One printed page: a decorative border at the top, then the title block centred, a large Hebrew letter as section heading, and the dictionary entries in running text in one column. The signature "A" stands at the foot.

main_text.head: JOHANNIS BUXTORFI MANUALE HEBRAICUM ET CHALDAICUM.
א
main_text.p: אָבִיב אָבַב [?] masc. Spica cum culmo, Arista. Est & mensis nomen, qui Martio nostro respondet.
אָב m. Vir, Virens, Fructus recens : plur. אָבִים. Chald. אָבָא, אִנְבָא cum Nun loco Dagesch, ex consuetudine Chaldaica.

אָבַד Periit. Chal. Futur. יֵאבְדוּ Peribunt, Jer.10.11. Pihel אִבֵּד Perire fecit, Perdidit. Hiphil הֶאֱבִיד idem. Chald. Infinit. לְהַאבְדָה Ad perdendum, Dan.2.12. Futur. תְּהוֹבֵד Perdes, Dan.4.24. Hic ל est loco א. Hophal, הוּבַד Perditum fuit.
אֲבַד m. Perditio, juxta quosdam : alias est Participium praesens in Kal.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied from a small, heavily inked print and several vowel points are uncertain; the forms marked [?] and the vowel-pointed Hebrew generally should be checked against the scan. The top ornamental border and the "I" at the head are treated as furniture and decoration. The large "א" is a section letter set as a heading.
